manifest.description: Synthetic playtest pack: 3 professions, 8 materials, 8 recipes with crafted items, 3 give-to-player recipe items. 3 locations (Normal/Hot/Deadly) with finite gathering nodes for the Locations module. Includes one GM-only material, one draft recipe/item and hidden location content as deliberate visibility examples. Not canon.
